notes: tRNA-seq: 60-100 nt RNA gel-purified, partially hydrolysed, 19-35 nt fragments made into small RNA libraries -> assay_class small_rna. The '23' construct (Ara_23/Glu_23) is not described anywhere, so genotype labels and is_control are left out for those samples; is_control left out for the whole study because the reference construct cannot be identified. PtuAB genotype_class left out: the text does not say whether PtuAB is native or foreign to the host. Arabinose (induce) / glucose (repress) are inducer settings, not treatments. growth_phase from ch:condition 'early stationary' -> transition.

culture_mode.q: cultured for 2h at 37°C with shaking at 200 rpm
